questions.question: Who is the leader from the land of Magog in Ezekiel 38?
What does God say Gog will do in the latter years?
options: Lead all of the exiles safely back again to their own homeland
Rebuild all of the ruined and broken cities of the far north
Make a lasting and firm peace with all of the people of God
Come against the restored land of Israel like a storm
questions.answer: Come against the restored land of Israel like a storm

questions.question: God declares that he will display his greatness and holiness before the nations through Gog's defeat.
Son of man, set your face toward _____, of the land of Magog.
You will come up against my people Israel like a _____ covering the land.
